# Matheus Abrahão

> Shopify expert and e-commerce engineer with 6+ years on Shopify. Started with his own store (Martin, martin4shop.com.br) and grew into running Shopify operations for international brands. Currently operates paired B2C and B2B Shopify storefronts — one enterprise-scale catalog with multi-level variants — for a US building-products manufacturer. Drove +455% sessions, +114% orders and +74% revenue for an international luxury fashion brand, and +254% sales, +324% orders and +1,700% sessions for a US-based beauty and lifestyle brand. Works remotely from Brazil (UTC-3) with e-commerce brands in the United States and Canada.

Shopify Expert e engenheiro de e-commerce. Trabalha remotamente para marcas nos EUA e Canadá. Especialista em Shopify Plus e Liquid, Matrixify, Salsify PIM, Klaviyo, SEO técnico, otimização de velocidade e migrações para Shopify.

## What He Does

- Shopify theme and Liquid development — custom sections, PDP and collection engineering, checkout extensibility, B2B storefronts
- Catalog operations at scale — Matrixify bulk imports and exports, multi-level variants, pricing and inventory sync, Salsify PIM syndication
- Klaviyo email and SMS — flow architecture, segmentation, list health, Shopify data integration, revenue attribution
- Shopify speed optimization — Core Web Vitals, third-party script audits, theme and image optimization
- Technical SEO for Shopify — structured data, schema markup, collection architecture, internal linking, AI-search readiness
- Shopify migrations — WooCommerce, Wix, Magento and BigCommerce to Shopify with data integrity and SEO-safe redirects

## Proof

- Operates paired B2C and B2B Shopify storefronts for a US building-products manufacturer — enterprise-scale catalog, multi-level variants, 7+ sales channels
- +455% sessions, +114% orders, +74% revenue for an international luxury fashion brand, as sole engineer
- +254% sales, +324% orders, +1,700% sessions in 12 months for a US-based beauty and lifestyle brand
- Catalog syndication to Lowe's, Home Depot (US and Canada), Menards and Amazon Seller and Vendor Central via Salsify PIM and Matrixify, with MAP/MSRP pricing parity across channels
- Founder of Martin (martin4shop.com.br), his own Shopify store: 1,959 orders, roughly R$552,000 processed, and 299,000+ sessions, operated end-to-end as a single founder
- Apple Swift Student Challenge 2026 — global winner (technical credibility; his professional work is Shopify)
